Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for PM SHRI Kendriya Vidyalaya Various Posts Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to attend the walk-in interview for PM SHRI Kendriya Vidyalaya?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview for Part Time Contractual Teachers posts at PM SHRI Kendriya Vidyalaya is scheduled for 21 September 2026. Candidates should ensure they reach the venue on time.

faq.question: Q2. What are the eligibility criteria for the PRT post?
faq.answer: For the PRT post, candidates need Senior Secondary with at least 50% marks and a 2-year Diploma in elementary education, or B.El.Ed., or a Diploma in Special Education, along with CTET Paper-1 qualification.

faq.question: Q3. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q4. What is the selection process for these contractual positions?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Part Time Contractual Teachers posts at PM SHRI Kendriya Vidyalaya will be based on an interview.

faq.question: Q5. What documents should I carry for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must carry all original documents, one set of self-attested photocopies of educational certificates, ID proof, and any other relevant documents as specified in the notification.

faq.answer: PM SHRI Kendriya Vidyalaya is located in Bagdogra, West Bengal, with the pincode 734421.
